scripts.text:
- Please stop here!! -
- You have carried too much items, -
- Therefore unable receive any item again, -
- Please reduce your weight, -
- And come back again later! -
scripts.translation:
- 請停在這裡！！ -
- 您攜帶的物品太多了， -
- 因此無法再接收任何物品， -
- 請減輕負重， -

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
I am Designer Heidam, who has all kinds of cool costumes in the World.
If you have any Kitcoins with you, come look for Designer Heidam!
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
我是設計師海丹，擁有世界上各種酷炫的服裝。
如果您身上有Kitcoin，請來找設計師海丹！

scripts.text: Exchange costume for random enchant box
scripts.translation: 用服裝兌換隨機附魔盒

scripts.text: Continue conversation
scripts.translation: 繼續對話

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Though I look out of shape right now, I used to be a well known fashion model and designer!
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
雖然我現在的樣子有點走樣，但我曾經是著名的時裝模特和設計師！

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Don't pity me! I am well aware of my looks, but I like who I am inside.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
別同情我！我很清楚自己的外表，但我喜歡內在的自己。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This item is useless to me! Do you have anything else?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這件物品對我沒用！你還有別的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Oh, then I can exchange it for a box of costume enchantment items.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
哦，那我可以用它兌換一個服裝附魔物品盒。

scripts.text: - Rummaging -
scripts.translation: - 翻找中 -

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
I see that you have a ^3131FF{0}^000000. Do you want to exchange this for a costume enchantment box?
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
我看到你有一個^3131FF{0}^000000。你想用它兌換一個服裝附魔盒嗎？

scripts.text: Exchange
scripts.translation: 兌換

scripts.text: Look for something else
scripts.translation: 找點別的

scripts.text: Stop Exchanging
scripts.translation: 停止兌換

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Oh~ Something suddenly disappeared...
Let me check you for another item to exchange...
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
哦~ 什麼東西突然不見了...
讓我再檢查一下你有沒有其他可以兌換的物品...

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Exchange Completed.
Let me check you for another item to exchange...
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
兌換完成。
讓我再檢查一下你有沒有其他可以兌換的物品...

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Meow? Where are you going?
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
喵？你要去哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Guess that is all.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
看來就這些了。

scripts.text: Look more
scripts.translation: 再看看

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Bye~
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
再見~

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
Welcome to Fashion Stone!!
scripts.translation:
[阿維爾·德·多什]
歡迎光臨時尚石！！

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
We take various costume items.
scripts.translation:
[阿維爾·德·多什]
我們回收各種服裝物品。

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
If you want cool styling for your costume, please come to me 'Aver De Dosh'!
Don't forget to bring ^ff0000your own costume and costume stones^000000~
scripts.translation:
[阿維爾·德·多什]
如果您想要酷炫的服裝造型，請來找“阿維爾·德·多什”！
別忘了帶上^ff0000您自己的服裝和服裝石^000000~

scripts.text: Apply enchant.
scripts.translation: 進行附魔

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話。

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
Please check our other upgrading services~
scripts.translation:
[阿維爾·德·多什]
請檢視我們的其他升級服務~

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
Kiaaaaach!!!
I hate bulging bags!
No matter how cool your costume looks, that fat bag of yours is a fashion terror you know!
scripts.translation:
[阿維爾·德·多什]
天哪！！！
我討厭鼓鼓囊囊的背包！
不管你的服裝多酷，那個胖乎乎的背包絕對是時尚災難，你知道嗎！

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
It seems you have too many items on you.
Come back after clearing some inventory space.
scripts.translation:
[阿維爾·德·多什]
看來你身上的物品太多了。
請清理一些背包空間後再來。

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
You must wear the costume you want to enchant.
Then, I will be able to help you out.
scripts.translation:
[阿維爾·德·多什]
你必須穿上想要附魔的服裝。
這樣我才能幫你。

scripts.text:

Well...
This costume is currently not available for an upgrade.
scripts.translation:

歷史以失敗著稱...
就像時尚的歷史一樣...
